description: A satellite image captured by Spot 5 on 2011-09-06, depicting a traditional irrigated agricultural area in Saka, Anatolia, Turkey. The image uses a 1/2/3 band combination, providing a resolution of 2.5 metres per pixel. The landscape is dominated by a patchwork of agricultural parcels, many of which appear vibrant bright green, indicating active vegetation or crops during the growing season. Interspersed with these green fields are numerous rectangular parcels of bare ground or fallow land, shown in shades of grey and brown. Linear features, likely irrigation channels or tracks, are visible dissecting and bordering some parcels. The parcels are generally regular in shape and range from small to medium in size. Scattered lighter grey areas may represent uncultivated land or dry soil. The overall pattern reflects a managed agricultural landscape with permanent irrigation infrastructure.
